issues.description: 接口名为“格式化指定本地硬盘”，但参数表中业务定位参数仅有 deviceSerial（其余为 accessToken、Content-Type 通用项），未提供任何磁盘标识参数（盘号/索引/路径），curl --data-raw 'null'；“指定”硬盘的选择方式未说明，且该操作为破坏性格式化。
issues.sdk_handling: 仅登记问题，不生成契约/绑定；不得自行添加磁盘参数或默认盘号。

issues.description: 请求地址为 /api/v3/otap/prop/{{deviceSerial}}/global/["0"]/HumanDetection/InDetectEnabled：占位符为双花括号 {{deviceSerial}}，且含字面量 ["0"] 段，占位语法与其他文档 {deviceSerial} 不一致，实际发送路径形态未确认。
issues.sdk_handling: 仅登记问题，不生成契约/绑定；不将 ["0"] 规整化为 0 或推断为数组索引语法。

issues.description: 参数表 Body data Boolean Y 与 curl 示例 --header 'Content-Type: application/json' + --data 'true' 相互印证：请求体为裸 Boolean 根值，body 类型已知（--data 与 --data-raw 的差异不构成歧义）。未确认项为：参数表未列 Content-Type 而 curl 携带，Content-Type 是否必选未知。另路径模板与适用型号未确认（已另列 issue），路径未确认故该接口当前不可调用。
issues.sdk_handling: 仅登记问题，不生成契约/绑定；body 已确认为裸 Boolean 根值，不得再标注 body 编码未知；Content-Type 必填性与路径模板未确认前不可调用。

issues.description: §1.12 declares GET and POST for /api/lapp/area/list (e1463) and demonstrates only a parameterless GET (e1468); the POST request shape — parameters, body encoding, and whether it requires a token — is not documented.
issues.sdk_handling: SDK selects GET only (global.settings.list_areas): one tokenless GET with no query and no body. The POST variant is recorded here rather than fabricated as a declared_pair or counted as a parser recovery.

issues.description: The single 2026-11-16 SP016 anonymous GET observation (HTTP 200, code "200", 240 items) is protocol-structure evidence, not SDK proof; 240 is a one-time count, not a guaranteed directory size, and other origins are unevidenced.
issues.sdk_handling: Contract pins GET /api/lapp/area/list on documented origin open.ezvizlife.com; SDK preserves the raw data array including extra fields and empty arrays, derives no cluster/apiDomain/authDomain, and hardcodes no item count.
